generator_cmd: python3 -I -c "import sys;print(' '.join(format(b,'08b') for b in sys.argv[1].encode()))" "$plain"  # plain 8-bit ASCII binary, not BCD
oracle_cmd: python3 -I -c "import sys;from sympy.combinatorics.graycode import gray_to_bin;print(bytes(int(gray_to_bin(g),2) for g in sys.argv[1].split()).decode())" "$encoded"  # sympy 1.14 gray_to_bin per 8-bit group -> plain binary Gray-decoded is junk ('tNBF?ZJ\\M?...'): the free reader rejects it (_texty < 0.9)
